notes: reasoning.effort supports low, medium, high, xhigh, and max; none and minimal are unsupported.
OpenAI does not declare a default reasoning effort in the reviewed GPT-6 Astra model documentation, so defaultMode remains null.
Tool calling requires the Responses API even though Chat Completions is also supported for non-tool model calls.
Chat Completions additionally does not support logprobs; Responses requests must remove message.output_text.logprobs from include.
GPT-6 Astra supports async tool calling on eligible developer-defined tools.
GPT-6 Astra supports mid-turn steering over Responses API WebSocket connections.
GPT-6 Astra supports mid-conversation reasoning-effort changes using configuration_update.
Code execution capability is grounded in documented Code Interpreter and hosted shell support.
Availability is limited while OpenAI rolls GPT-6 Astra out first to Trusted Access organizations and expands API access over the following days.
